paper_title: Incorporating Domain Knowledge into Materials Tokenization
caption: Comparison of Macro-F1 scores for MATTER and w/o material knowledge across during tokenization training different number of tokens.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of tokens and the Macro-F1 Score percentage, comparing two different conditions. The x-axis is labeled "Number of tokens," has a linear scale, and ranges from approximately 0.6 to 1.4, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis is labeled "Macro-F1 Score (%)" with a linear scale, ranging from 48 to 58, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The first line, representing "MATTER (ours)," is colored pink with circular markers and a solid line style. It starts at a Macro-F1 Score of about 55% at the beginning of the x-axis of around 0.5 number of tokens, peaks at around 58% near x=1.0, and ends at approximately 51% near the end of the range of around x=1.3. The second line, labeled "w/o material information," is purple with circular markers and a solid line style. It begins at a Macro-F1 Score of about 52.5%, peaks slightly near the start to its peak point of around 54% at x =0.7, and then gradually declines, ending at approximately 48%. Both lines depict variations in scores with overlapping shaded areas representing possible variance without the actual overlapping between the 2 lines at any point. A legend positioned near the bottom-left of the plot defines each line by its corresponding conditional information, marker shape and color
